note.kid: The message itself, inside the locked box.
note.nerd: The application message: a request for the next video segment, or a piece of the response.

ask.kid: “Please send me the next bit of the cat video!”
ask.nerd: A request for the next video segment.

send.kid: “Here’s the next bit of the cat video!”
send.nerd: A response: the next video segment.

start.about: The request (method and path) or the response status.

header.name: Header
header.about: One of several header lines; the rest of the headers and the body follow.
